verses.geez: ወነገሮሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ።
verses.translation: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.

translations.lxx: And Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the Lord commanded Moses.
translations.kjv: And Moses spake unto the heads of the tribes concerning the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the LORD hath commanded.
translations.ron: Moise a spus fiilor lui Israel toate cele ce-i poruncise Domnul.
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Μωυσῆς τοῖς υἱοῖς Ἰσραὴλ κατὰ πάντα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ.

verses.geez:
ወነገሮሙ ፡ ሙሴ ፡ ለመላእክተ ፡ ሕዝብ ፡ ደቂቀ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወይቤሎሙ ፡ ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ቃል ፡ ዘአዘዘ ፡
                  እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded.

translations.lxx: And Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, This is the thing which the Lord has commanded.
translations.kjv: If a man vow a vow unto the LORD, or swear an oath to bind his soul with a bond; he shall not break his word, he shall do according to all that proceedeth out of his mouth.
translations.ron: Aşadar, a grăit Moise către căpeteniile seminţiilor fiilor lui Israel şi le-a zis: "Iată ce porunceşte Domnul:
translations.grk: Καὶ ἐλάλησε Μωυσῆς πρὸς τοὺς ἄρχοντας τῶν φυλῶν υἱῶν Ἰσραὴλ, λέγων, τοῦτο τὸ ῥῆμα ὃ συνέταξε Κύριος.

verses.geez:
ብእሲ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ለእመቦ ፡ ዘበፅዐ ፡ ብፅዐተ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ ወለእመኒ ፡ መሐለ ፡ መሐላ ፡ አው ፡ ፈለጠ ፡ ፍሉጠ
                  ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሱ ፡ ኢይገምን ፡ ቃሎ ፤ ኵሎ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ እምአፉሁ ፡ ይግበር ።
verses.translation: Whatsoever man shall vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath, or bind himself with an obligation upon his soul, he shall not break his word; all that shall come out of his mouth he shall do.

translations.lxx: Whatsoever man shall vow a vow to the Lord, or swear an oath, or bind himself with an obligation upon his soul, he shall not break his word; all that shall come out of his mouth he shall do.
translations.kjv: If a woman also vow a vow unto the LORD, and bind herself by a bond, being in her father’s house in her youth;
translations.ron: Omul care va face făgăduinţă Domnului sau se va jura cu jurământ, punând legătură asupra sufletului său, să nu-şi calce cuvântul, ci să împlinească toate câte au ieşit din gura lui.
translations.grk: Ἄνθρωπος ἄνθρωπος ὃς ἂν εὔξηται εὐχὴν Κυρίῳ, ἢ ὀμόσῃ ὅρκον, ἢ ὁρίσηται ὁρισμῷ περὶ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτοῦ, οὐ βεβηλώσει τὸ ῥῆμα αὐτοῦ· πάντα ὅσα ἂν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ, ποιήσει.

verses.geez: ወለእመኒ ፡ ብእሲት ፡ በፅዐት ፡ ብፅዓተ ፡ ለእግዚአብሔር ፡ አው ፡ ፈለጠት ፡ ፍሉጠ ፡ በቤተ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ በንእሳ ፤
verses.translation: And if a woman shall vow a vow to the Lord, or bind herself with an obligation in her youth in her father's house; and her father should hear her vows and her obligations, wherewith she has bound her soul, and her father should hold his peace at her, then all her vows shall stand,

translations.lxx: And if a woman shall vow a vow to the Lord, or bind herself with an obligation in her youth in her father's house; and her father should hear her vows and her obligations, wherewith she has bound her soul, and her father should hold his peace at her, then all her vows shall stand,
translations.kjv: And her father hear her vow, and her bond wherewith she hath bound her soul, and her father shall hold his peace at her: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she hath bound her soul shall stand.
translations.ron: Dacă vreo femeie va da făgăduinţă Domnului şi va pune asupra sa legământul, în casa părintelui său, în tinereţea sa,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ εὔξηται γυνὴ εὐχὴν Κυρίῳ, ἢ ὁρίσηται ὁρισμὸν ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ πατρὸς αὐτῆς ἐν τῇ νεότητι αὐτῆς,

verses.geez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ወኵሎ ፡ ብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ዘበፅዐት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ወተጸመመ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ ወይቀውም ፡
                  ላዕሌሃ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ዘበፅዐት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ይነብር ፡ ዲቤሃ ።
verses.translation: and all the obligations with which she has bound her soul, shall remain to her.

translations.lxx: and all the obligations with which she has bound her soul, shall remain to her.
translations.kjv: But if her father disallow her in the day that he heareth; not any of her vows, or of her bonds wherewith she hath bound her soul, shall stand: and the LORD shall forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
translations.ron: Şi va auzi tatăl făgăduinţa ei şi legământul ce ea şi-a pus asupra sufletului său, şi va tăcea tatăl ei asupra acestora, atunci toate făgăduinţele ei se vor ţine şi orice legământ şi-ar fi pus ea asupra sufletului său se va ţine.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀκούσῃ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς, καὶ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς αὐτῆς, οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, καὶ παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῆς ὁ πατὴρ, καὶ στήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς, καὶ πάντες οἱ ὁρισμοὶ οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, μενοῦσιν αὐτῇ·

verses.geez:
ወለእመሰ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ አቡሃ ፡ ወፈጸመ ፡ ላቲ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ወብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ዘበፅአት ፡
                  በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ኢይነብር ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ወያነጽሐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ አቡሃ ።
verses.translation: But if her father straitly forbid her in the day in which he shall hear all her vows and her obligations, which she has contracted upon her soul, they shall not stand; and the Lord shall hold her guiltless, because her father forbade her.

translations.lxx: But if her father straitly forbid her in the day in which he shall hear all her vows and her obligations, which she has contracted upon her soul, they shall not stand; and the Lord shall hold her guiltless, because her father forbade her.
translations.kjv: And if she had at all an husband, when she vowed, or uttered ought out of her lips, wherewith she bound her soul;
translations.ron: Iar dacă tatăl ei, auzind, o va opri, atunci toate făgăduinţele ei şi legămintele ce ea şi-ar fi pus asupra sufletului său nu se vor ţine şi Domnul o va ierta, pentru că a oprit-o tatăl ei.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἀνανεύων ἀνανεύσῃ ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς, ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ πάσας τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς καὶ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς, οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, οὐ στήσονται· καὶ Κύριος καθαριεῖ αὐτὴν, ὅτι ἀνένευσεν ὁ πατὴρ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወለአመሰ ፡ አውሰበት ፡ ብእሴ ፡ ወሀለወ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ነበበት ፡ በከናፍሪሃ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘበፅአት ፡
                  በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፤
verses.translation: But if she should be indeed married, and her vows be upon her according to the utterance of her lips, in respect of the obligations which she has contracted upon her soul;

translations.lxx: But if she should be indeed married, and her vows be upon her according to the utterance of her lips, in respect of the obligations which she has contracted upon her soul;
translations.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her in the day that he heard it: then her vows shall stand, and her bonds wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
translations.ron: Dacă însă ea se va mărita şi va fi asupra ei făgăduinţa sau cuvântul gurii sale, cu care s-a legat pe sine,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ γενομένη γένηται ἀνδρὶ, καὶ αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς ἐπʼ αὐτῇ κατὰ τὴν διαστολὴν τῶν χειλέων αὐτῆς, οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς,

verses.geez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወተጸመማ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ከማሁ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ወብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ዘበፅዐት
                  ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ ዲቤሃ ።
verses.translation: and her husband should hear, and hold his peace at her in the day in which he should hear, then thus shall all her vows be binding, and her obligations, which she has contracted upon her soul shall stand.

translations.lxx: and her husband should hear, and hold his peace at her in the day in which he should hear, then thus shall all her vows be binding, and her obligations, which she has contracted upon her soul shall stand.
translations.kjv: But if her husband disallowed her on the day that he heard it; then he shall make her vow which she vowed, and that which she uttered with her lips, wherewith she bound her soul, of none effect: and the LORD shall forgive her.
translations.ron: Şi va auzi bărbatul ei şi, auzind-o, va tăcea, atunci făgăduinţele ei se vor ţine şi legămintele ce ea şi-a pus asupra sufletului său se vor ţine.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀκούσῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, καὶ παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῇ ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ, καὶ οὕτω στήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ ὁρισμοὶ αὐτῆς, οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, στήσονται.

verses.geez:
ወእመሰ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወፈጸመ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ወብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ዘበፅዐት ፡ በእንተ ፡
                  ነፍሳ ፡ ኢይነብር ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ እስመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወያነጽሐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: But if her husband should straitly forbid her in the day in which he should hear her, none of her vows or obligations which she has contracted upon her soul shall stand, because her husband has disallowed her, and the Lord shall hold her guiltless.

translations.lxx: But if her husband should straitly forbid her in the day in which he should hear her, none of her vows or obligations which she has contracted upon her soul shall stand, because her husband has disallowed her, and the Lord shall hold her guiltless.
translations.kjv: But every vow of a widow, and of her that is divorced, wherewith they have bound their souls, shall stand against her.
translations.ron: Iar dacă bărbatul ei, auzind, o va opri şi va lepăda făgăduinţa ei, care este asupra ei, şi cuvântul gurii ei cu care ea s-a legat pe sine, atunci acestea nu se vor ţine, pentru că i le-a oprit bărbatul ei, şi Domnul o va ierta.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἀνανεύων ἀνανεύσῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς ᾗ ἐὰν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ, πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς, καὶ οἱ ὁρισμοὶ αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, οὐ μενοῦσιν, ὅτι ὁ ἀνὴρ ἀνένευσεν ἀπʼ αὐτῆς· καὶ Κύριος καθαριεῖ αὐτήν.

verses.geez: ወጸሎታሂ ፡ ለመበለት ፡ ወለእንተ ፡ አውጽአ ፡ ምታ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘበፅአት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ይሄሉ ፡ ላዕሌሃ ።
verses.translation: And the vow of a widow and of her that is put away, whatsoever she shall bind upon her soul, shall stand to her.

translations.lxx: And the vow of a widow and of her that is put away, whatsoever she shall bind upon her soul, shall stand to her.
translations.kjv: And if she vowed in her husband’s house, or bound her soul by a bond with an oath;
translations.ron: Iar făgăduinţa văduvei şi a celei despărţite şi orice legământ şi-ar pune aceasta asupra sufletului ei se va ţine.
translations.grk: Καὶ εὐχὴ χήρας καὶ ἐκβεβλημένης ὅσα ἐὰν εὔξηται κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, μενοῦσιν αὐτῇ.

verses.geez: ወለእመኒ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ቤተ ፡ ምታ ፡ ጸለየት ፡ ወበፅአት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፤
verses.translation: And if her vow be made in the house of her husband, or the obligation upon her soul with an oath,

translations.lxx: And if her vow be made in the house of her husband, or the obligation upon her soul with an oath,
translations.kjv: And her husband heard it, and held his peace at her, and disallowed her not: then all her vows shall stand, and every bond wherewith she bound her soul shall stand.
translations.ron: Dacă însă în casa bărbatului său a dat făgăduinţă sau şi-a pus legământ asupra sufletului său cu jurământ,
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ ἐν τῷ οἴκῳ τοῦ ἀνδρὸς αὐτῆς ἡ εὐχὴ αὐτῆς, ἢ ὁ ὁρισμὸς κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς μεθʼ ὅρκου,

verses.geez:
ወሰምዐ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወተጸመማ ፡ ወኢገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ብፅዓቲሃ ፡ ዘበፅዐት ፡
                  በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ይቀውም ፡ ዲቤሃ ።
verses.translation: and her husband should hear, and hold his peace at her, and not disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the obligations which she contracted against her soul, shall stand against her.

translations.lxx: and her husband should hear, and hold his peace at her, and not disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and all the obligations which she contracted against her soul, shall stand against her.
translations.kjv: But if her husband hath utterly made them void on the day he heard them; then whatsoever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband hath made them void; and the LORD shall forgive her.
translations.ron: Şi bărbatul ei a auzit şi a tăcut asupra acesteia şi n-a oprit-o, atunci toate făgăduinţele ei se vor ţine şi orice legământ şi-ar fi pus asupra sufletului său se va ţine.
translations.grk: καὶ ἀκούσῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς, καὶ παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῇ, καὶ μὴ ἀνανεύσῃ αὐτῇ, καὶ στήσονται πᾶσαι αἱ εὐχαὶ αὐτῆς, καὶ πάντες οἱ ὁρισμοὶ αὐτῆς οὓς ὡρίσατο κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, στήσονται κατʼ αὐτῆς.

verses.geez:
ወለእመሰ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወፈጸመ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘወፅአ ፡ እምከናፍሪሃ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ጸለየት ፡
                  ወዘከመ ፡ በፅአት ፡ በእንተ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ኢይነብር ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ እስመ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ምታ ፡ ወያነጽሐ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ።
verses.translation: But if her husband should utterly cancel the vow in the day in which he shall hear it, none of the things which shall proceed out of her lips in her vows, and in the obligations contracted upon her soul, shall stand to her; her husband has cancelled them, and the Lord shall hold her guiltless.

translations.lxx: But if her husband should utterly cancel the vow in the day in which he shall hear it, none of the things which shall proceed out of her lips in her vows, and in the obligations contracted upon her soul, shall stand to her; her husband has cancelled them, and the Lord shall hold her guiltless.
translations.kjv: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.
translations.ron: Dacă însă bărbatul ei, auzind, a lepădat făgăduinţele, atunci toate făgăduinţele ieşite din gura ei şi legămintele sufletului său nu se vor ţine, pentru că bărbatul ei le-a desfiinţat şi Domnul o va ierta.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ περιελὼν περιέλῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς ᾗ ἂν ἡμέρᾳ ἀκούσῃ, πάντα ὅσα ἐὰν ἐξέλθῃ ἐκ τῶν χειλέων αὐτῆς κατὰ τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς, καὶ κατὰ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς τοὺς κατὰ τῆς ψυχῆς αὐτῆς, οὐ μενεῖ αὐτῇ· ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς περιεῖλε, καὶ Κύριος καθαριεῖ αὐτήν.

verses.geez:
ወኵሉ ፡ ብፅዓት ፡ ወኵሉ ፡ ማእሰረ ፡ መሐላ ፡ ዘይከውን ፡ እኩየ ፡ ላዕለ ፡ ነፍሳ ፡ ምታ ፡ ያቀውም ፡ ላቲ ፡ ወምታ
                  ፡ ይገብር ፡ ላቲ ።
verses.translation: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband shall confirm it to her, or her husband shall cancel it.

translations.lxx: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict her soul, her husband shall confirm it to her, or her husband shall cancel it.
translations.kjv: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day; then he establisheth all her vows, or all her bonds, which are upon her: he confirmeth them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.
translations.ron: Orice făgăduinţă şi orice legământ cu jurământ pentru smerirea sufletului ei, bărbatul ei îl poate întări şi tot bărbatul ei îl poate şi desfiinţa.
translations.grk: Πᾶσα εὐχὴ καὶ πᾶς ὅρκος δεσμοῦ κακῶσαι ψυχὴν, ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς στήσει αὐτῇ, καὶ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς περιελεῖ

verses.geez:
ወለእመሰ ፡ ተጸመማ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ እምዕለት ፡ [ያ]ቀውም ፡ ላዕሌሃ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ጸሎታ ፡ ወብፅዓቲሃኒ ፡ [ያ]ቀውም ፡ ዲቤሃ
                  ፡ እስመ ፡ ተጸመማ ፡ በዕለተ ፡ ሰምዐ ።
verses.translation: But if he be wholly silent at her from day to day, then shall he bind upon her all her vows; and he shall confirm to her the obligations which she has bound upon herself, because he held his peace at her in the day in which he heard her.

translations.lxx: But if he be wholly silent at her from day to day, then shall he bind upon her all her vows; and he shall confirm to her the obligations which she has bound upon herself, because he held his peace at her in the day in which he heard her.
translations.kjv: But if he shall any ways make them void after that he hath heard them; then he shall bear her iniquity.
translations.ron: Dacă însă bărbatul ei a tăcut despre aceasta, zi după zi, prin aceasta el a întărit toate făgăduinţele ei şi toate legămintele ce sunt asupra ei le-a întărit, pentru că el a auzit şi a tăcut.
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ σιωπῶν παρασιωπήσῃ αὐτῇ ἡμέραν ἐξ ἡμέρας, καὶ στήσει αὐτῇ πάσας τὰς εὐχὰς αὐτῆς, καὶ τοὺς ὁρισμοὺς τοὺς ἐπʼ αὐτῆς στήσει αὐτῇ, ὅτι ἐσιώπησεν αὐτῇ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ ἤκουσεν.

verses.geez: ወለእመሰ ፡ ገብረ ፡ ላቲ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ዕለት ፡ እንተ ፡ ባቲ ፡ ሰምዐ ፡ ይከውኖ ፡ ኀጢአተ ።
verses.translation: And if her husband should in any wise cancel them after the day in which he heard them, then he shall bear his iniquity.

translations.lxx: And if her husband should in any wise cancel them after the day in which he heard them, then he shall bear his iniquity.
translations.kjv: These are the statutes, which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between the father and his daughter, being yet in her youth in her father’s house.
translations.ron: Iar dacă bărbatul le-a lepădat după ce le-a auzit, atunci a luat el asupra sa păcatul ei".
translations.grk: Ἐὰν δὲ περιελὼν περιέλῃ ὁ ἀνὴρ αὐτῆς μετὰ τὴν ἡμέραν ἣν ἤκουσε, καὶ λήψεται τὴν ἁμαρτίαν αὐτοῦ.

verses.geez:
ዝንቱ ፡ ውእቱ ፡ ኵነኔ ፡ ኵሉ ፡ ዘአዘዞ ፡ እግዚአብሔር ፡ ለሙሴ ፡ ማእከለ ፡ ብእሲ ፡ ወማእከለ ፡ ብእሲቱ ፡ ወማእከለ
                  ፡ አብ ፡ ወወለቱ ፡ በንእሳ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ሀለወት ፡ ቤተ ፡ አቡሃ ።
verses.translation: These are the ordinances which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and daughter in her youth in the house of her father.

translations.lxx: These are the ordinances which the Lord commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, and between a father and daughter in her youth in the house of her father.
translations.ron: Acestea sunt legile, pe care Domnul le-a poruncit lui Moise asupra legămintelor dintre bărbat şi femeia lui, dintre tată şi fiica lui, cât aceasta este tânără şi se află în casa tatălui ei.
translations.grk: Ταῦτα τὰ δικαιώματα ὅσα ἐνετείλατο Κύριος τῷ Μωυσῇ, ἀναμέσον ἀνδρὸς καὶ γυναικὸς αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἀναμέσον πατρὸς καὶ θυγατρὸς ἐν νεότητι ἐ οἴκῳ πατρός.
